변경 이유: 진단의 stall 대응으로, 회피 모드가 느리게 멀어지는 물체에서도 끝나도록 종료 조건만 바꿨습니다. 방향 1·3·4·6에 따라 `_DDOT_END=0.05`, `_EV_INC_TOL=0.02`, `_AWAY_V=0.01`, `_AWAY_S=0.5`로 바꿨고, 방향 2·5에 따라 `end_rise`가 `_EV_INC_S=1.0`초 창의 평균 거리 변화율 > 0.02 m/s 이면 끝나게 했습니다. 방향 1의 "0.5초 기준 0.05 m/s"와 방향 5의 "0.02"가 서로 겹치므로, 0.5초 창에서 0.05 m/s 초과(또는 물체가 `_EARLY_R` 밖)이거나 1.0초 창에서 0.02 m/s 초과이면 종료되도록 두 조건을 함께 두었습니다. `_EV_INC_S`를 같이 쓰던 정지 물체 종료(`end_still`)는 진단 대상이 아니므로 새 상수 `_EV_STILL_S=0.5`로 분리해 기존 동작을 유지했고, 나머지 로직은 시도 22와 같습니다.

```python
def controller(t, pose, env):
    """Waypoint law + 2D-lidar mover handling (attempt 23):
    - evasion end by distance rate (directions 1, 2, 3, 5): d_near sampled every 0.1 s may drop at most _EV_INC_TOL
      (0.02 m) per sample; evasion ends when, since the rise started, either
        el >= _EV_INC_SHORT (0.5 s) and (mover farther than _EARLY_R or window-average d_dot > _DDOT_END (0.05 m/s)), or
        el >= _EV_INC_S (1.0 s) and window-average d_dot > _DDOT_WIN_MIN (0.02 m/s)
    - receding end (directions 4, 6): _AWAY_V = 0.01 m/s, must hold _AWAY_S = 0.5 s
    - stationary-mover end keeps its 0.5 s window via _EV_STILL_S (unchanged behaviour)
    - all other logic and parameters unchanged from attempt 22"""
    S = _CS
    if not S:
        S.update(idx=0, tracks=[], mv={"front": np.zeros((0, 2)), "back": np.zeros((0, 2))},
                 mt={"front": -99.0, "back": -99.0}, last={}, v=0.0, w=0.0,
                 slow=False, stopped=False, n_stop=0, stop_t=0.0, stop_sum=0.0,
                 started=False, reported=False,
                 evading=False, ev_logged=False, evade_until=-1.0, n_evade=0, evade_t=0.0, evade_sum=0.0,
                 evade_on=False, evade_start=0.0, cool_until=-1.0, st_prio=False,
                 d_samp=9.0, samp_t=-99.0, inc_since=-1.0, inc_d0=9.0, stat_since=-1.0, stat_d0=9.0,
                 away_since=-1.0, n_force=0, narrow_end=-1.0, n_prox=0,
                 stall_since=-1.0, stall_d0=9.0, retry_until=-1.0, n_retry=0, n_app=0)
    x, y, yaw = pose
    n = len(_WAYPOINTS)

    # 1) sensing: both 2D lidars -> world points -> drop static map -> mover clusters/tracks
    fresh = {}
    for which in ("front", "back"):
        p = lidar2d_points(which)
        if p.shape[0] > 0 and p is not S["last"].get(which):
            S["last"][which] = p
            S["mv"][which] = _ingest(p, pose, abs(S["w"]))
            S["mt"][which] = t
            fresh[which] = True
    if fresh.get("front") or (fresh.get("back") and t - S["mt"]["front"] > 0.25):
        parts = [S["mv"][k] for k in ("front", "back") if t - S["mt"][k] < 0.25]
        _update_tracks(np.concatenate(parts) if parts else np.zeros((0, 2)), t)

    if not S["started"]:   # look before the first move (a mover may be near START)
        if not ((S["mt"]["front"] > -1.0 and t >= 0.3) or t >= 2.0):
            return 0.0, 0.0, False
        S["started"] = True

    # 2) goal alignment / finish
    if S["idx"] >= n and math.hypot(GOAL[0] - x, GOAL[1] - y) > 0.5:
        S["idx"] = n - 1
    if S["idx"] >= n and abs(_wrap_angle(GOAL[2] - yaw)) < 0.05:
        _log_stop(t, pose, False, 9.0)
        _log_evade(t, pose, False, 99.0, 9.0)
        if not S["reported"]:
            S["reported"] = True
            print("[C2 debug] done t=%.2f stop_episodes=%d stopped_total=%.2fs evade_episodes=%d evade_total=%.2fs "
                  "forced_ends=%d prox_triggers=%d stall_retries=%d approach_escapes=%d"
                  % (t, S["n_stop"], S["stop_sum"], S["n_evade"], S["evade_sum"], S["n_force"], S["n_prox"],
                     S["n_retry"], S["n_app"]),
                  flush=True)
        return 0.0, 0.0, True

    # 3) nominal command (verified law) and its predicted safety against ALL movers
    v_n, w_n, S["idx"] = _nominal_cmd(x, y, yaw, S["idx"], 1.0)
    target = _WAYPOINTS[min(S["idx"], n - 1)]
    P, U = _movers_now(t)

    d_near = _nearest_mover(P, pose)
    ttc = _ttc(P, U, pose, S["v"], _EARLY_R)
    anchors = _mover_anchors(t, pose)

    app_rel = -_closing_speed(P, U, pose, S["v"], _PROX_D)   # >0: approaching (robot motion included)
    app_own = -_closing_speed(P, U, pose, 0.0, _PROX_D)      # >0: the mover itself approaches
    prox = d_near < _PROX_D and app_rel > _PROX_V
    hard = d_near < _EV_STOP_HARD and app_rel > _PROX_V

    traj_n = _rollout_nominal(pose, S["idx"], S["v"], 1.0)
    st_n = _static_clearance(traj_n[None, :_KS + 1])[0]
    clr_all = _mover_clearance(traj_n[None], P, U)[0]
    st0 = _pose_static_clearance(pose)
    narrow = st_n < _EV_TRIG_ST

    # evasion trigger: TTC or proximity-approach
    if (ttc < _TTC_TRIG or prox) and (t >= S["cool_until"] or clr_all < _CLR_GO or hard):
        if not S["evade_on"]:
            S["evade_on"] = True
            S["evade_start"] = t
            S["evade_until"] = t
            S["narrow_end"] = -1.0
            S["st_prio"] = st0 < _ST_PRIO
            if prox and ttc >= _TTC_TRIG:
                S["n_prox"] += 1
                print("[C2 debug] prox trigger #%d t=%.2f pos=(%.2f, %.2f) dist=%.2f app=%.2f ttc=%.2f"
                      % (S["n_prox"], t, x, y, d_near, app_rel, ttc), flush=True)
        S["evading"] = True
        if narrow and S["narrow_end"] < 0.0:
            S["narrow_end"] = t + _EV_NARROW_CAP
        cap = S["evade_start"] + _EVADE_MAX
        if S["narrow_end"] >= 0.0:
            cap = min(cap, S["narrow_end"])
        S["evade_until"] = min(max(S["evade_until"], t + _EVADE_HOLD), cap)
        S["inc_since"] = -1.0
        S["stat_since"] = -1.0
        S["away_since"] = -1.0
    sample = t - S["samp_t"] >= _EV_SAMP_DT - 1e-9
    if S["evade_on"]:
        if S["st_prio"] and st0 >= _ST_PRIO:
            S["st_prio"] = False
        end_force = (t - S["evade_start"] >= _EVADE_MAX - 1e-9
                     or (S["narrow_end"] >= 0.0 and t >= S["narrow_end"] - 1e-9))
        end_rise = end_still = end_away = False
        if sample:
            far = d_near >= _EARLY_R
            d_prev = S["d_samp"]
            # attempt 23 / direction 3: per-sample noise tolerance _EV_INC_TOL (0.02 m)
            rising = (not prox) and ttc >= _TTC_TRIG and (far or d_near >= d_prev - _EV_INC_TOL)
            if rising:
                if S["inc_since"] < 0.0:
                    S["inc_since"] = t
                    S["inc_d0"] = d_near
            else:
                S["inc_since"] = -1.0
            # attempt 23 / directions 1, 2, 5: window-average distance rate
            #   0.5 s window: far or d_dot > _DDOT_END (0.05 m/s)
            #   1.0 s window (_EV_INC_S): d_dot > _DDOT_WIN_MIN (0.02 m/s)
            el = t - S["inc_since"]
            ddot_win = (d_near - S["inc_d0"]) / max(el, _EV_SAMP_DT)
            inc_on = S["inc_since"] >= 0.0
            end_short = el >= _EV_INC_SHORT - 1e-9 and (far or ddot_win > _DDOT_END)
            end_long = el >= _EV_INC_S - 1e-9 and ddot_win > _DDOT_WIN_MIN
            end_rise = inc_on and (end_short or end_long)
            still_m = (not narrow) and (not far) and ttc >= _TTC_NONE and abs(d_near - d_prev) <= _EV_STILL_TOL
            if still_m:
                if S["stat_since"] < 0.0:
                    S["stat_since"] = t
                    S["stat_d0"] = d_near
            else:
                S["stat_since"] = -1.0
            end_still = (S["stat_since"] >= 0.0 and t - S["stat_since"] >= _EV_STILL_S - 1e-9
                         and abs(d_near - S["stat_d0"]) <= _EV_STILL_WIN)
            away = (not prox) and (not narrow) and ttc >= _TTC_TRIG and _movers_receding(anchors, pose)
            if away:
                if S["away_since"] < 0.0:
                    S["away_since"] = t
            else:
                S["away_since"] = -1.0
            end_away = S["away_since"] >= 0.0 and t - S["away_since"] >= _AWAY_S - 1e-9
        if end_force or end_rise or end_still or end_away:
            normal = end_rise or end_still or end_away
            S["cool_until"] = t + (_EVADE_COOL if normal else _EVADE_FORCE_COOL)
            if not normal:
                S["n_force"] += 1
                print("[C2 debug] evade forced end t=%.2f pos=(%.2f, %.2f) dist=%.2f ttc=%.2f st_n=%.2f"
                      % (t, x, y, d_near, ttc, st_n), flush=True)
            S["evade_on"] = False
            S["evading"] = False
            S["narrow_end"] = -1.0
            S["inc_since"] = -1.0
            S["stat_since"] = -1.0
            S["away_since"] = -1.0
            S["st_prio"] = False
    if sample:
        S["d_samp"] = d_near
        S["samp_t"] = t
    early = S["evading"]

    # slow mode on clr_all with hysteresis (enter < _CLR_GO, leave >= _HYST * _CLR_GO)
    if S["slow"]:
        if st_n >= 0.0 and clr_all >= _CLR_GO * _HYST:
            S["slow"] = False
    elif clr_all < _CLR_GO:
        S["slow"] = True

    # 4) decide
    stop = False
    wide = early and _EV_STOP_HARD <= d_near < _EV_WIDE_D
    cands = _CAND_WIDE if wide else None
    wset = _EV_W_WIDE if wide else None
    band = early and _EV_STOP_HARD <= d_near < _EV_STOP_D and app_own > _PROX_V
    band_still_ok = False
    if band:
        still_long = np.tile(np.array([x, y, yaw], dtype=np.float64), (_KP + 1, 1))[None]
        band_still_ok = _mover_clearance(still_long, P, U)[0] >= _CLR_STOP
    retry = t < S["retry_until"]
    if retry:
        v, w, _ = _choose(pose, P, U, target, anchors, True, S["st_prio"] or st0 < _ST_PRIO, _CAND_WIDE)
    elif early and d_near < _EV_STOP_HARD:
        still_tr = np.tile(np.array([x, y, yaw], dtype=np.float64), (_EV_STILL_KP + 1, 1))[None]
        still_clr = float(_mover_clearance(still_tr, P, U)[0])
        close_still = _closing_speed(P, U, pose, 0.0, _CLOSE_R)   # robot standing: <0 = a mover closes in
        if still_clr < _EV_STILL_CLR:
            v, w, _ = _choose(pose, P, U, target, anchors, True, S["st_prio"], _CAND_WIDE)
        elif S["stopped"] and close_still < _CLOSE_V:
            S["retry_until"] = t + _STALL_RETRY_S
            S["stall_since"] = -1.0
            S["n_app"] += 1
            print("[C2 debug] approach escape #%d t=%.2f pos=(%.2f, %.2f) dist=%.2f closing=%.2f still_clr=%.2f"
                  % (S["n_app"], t, x, y, d_near, close_still, still_clr), flush=True)
            retry = True
            v, w, _ = _choose(pose, P, U, target, anchors, True, S["st_prio"] or st0 < _ST_PRIO, _CAND_WIDE)
        else:
            v, w = 0.0, 0.0
            stop = True
    elif band and band_still_ok:
        v, w = 0.0, 0.0      # mover itself approaching 1.0-1.5 m away and standing is safe -> let it pass
        stop = True
    elif early and (wide or st_n < _NARROW_ST):
        lat = _narrow_lateral(pose, P, U, target, anchors, wset)
        if lat is not None:
            v, w = lat
        else:
            v, w, _ = _choose(pose, P, U, target, anchors, True, S["st_prio"] or st0 < _ST_PRIO, cands)
    elif st_n < 0.0:
        v, w, _ = _choose(pose, P, U, target, anchors, True, st0 < _ST_PRIO, cands)
    elif early:
        v, w, _ = _choose(pose, P, U, target, anchors, True, S["st_prio"], cands)
    elif not S["slow"]:
        if clr_all >= _CLR_STOP:
            v, w = v_n, w_n
        else:
            v, w, _ = _choose(pose, P, U, target, anchors)
    else:
        v, w, stop, st_block = _slow_cmd(pose, S["idx"], S["v"], clr_all, P, U)
        if stop and (st_block or st0 < _ST_PRIO):
            v, w, _ = _choose(pose, P, U, target, anchors, True, True)
        elif stop or S["stopped"]:
            closing = _closing_speed(P, U, pose, S["v"], _CLOSE_R)
            hit_still = False
            if stop:
                still_tr = np.tile(np.array([x, y, yaw], dtype=np.float64), (_KP + 1, 1))[None]
                hit_still = _mover_clearance(still_tr, P, U)[0] < _CLR_STOP
            if hit_still or closing < _CLOSE_V:
                v, w, _ = _choose(pose, P, U, target, anchors)

    # standstill for _STALL_S without the mover distance rising -> forced evasion retry
    still_cmd = abs(v) < _STILL_V and abs(w) < _STALL_W
    if still_cmd and not retry:
        if S["stall_since"] < 0.0 or d_near > S["stall_d0"] + _STALL_INC:
            S["stall_since"] = t
            S["stall_d0"] = d_near
        elif t - S["stall_since"] >= _STALL_S - 1e-9:
            S["retry_until"] = t + _STALL_RETRY_S
            S["stall_since"] = -1.0
            S["n_retry"] += 1
            print("[C2 debug] stall retry #%d t=%.2f pos=(%.2f, %.2f) dist=%.2f d0=%.2f"
                  % (S["n_retry"], t, x, y, d_near, S["stall_d0"]), flush=True)
    else:
        S["stall_since"] = -1.0

    _log_evade(t, pose, early, ttc, d_near)
    _log_stop(t, pose, stop, clr_all)
    S["v"], S["w"] = v, w
    return v, w, False


_EV_INC_S = 1.0         # attempt 23 / direction 2: long evasion-end window [s] for the 1.0 s average distance rate (was 0.5 s)


_EV_INC_TOL = 0.02      # attempt 23 / direction 3: d_near drop [m] per 0.1 s sample tolerated in the end window (was 0.05)


_AWAY_V = 0.01          # attempt 23 / direction 4: mover speed component away from the robot [m/s] counted as receding (was 0.05)


_AWAY_S = 0.5           # attempt 23 / direction 6: receding condition must hold this long [s] before evasion ends (was 0.3)


_DDOT_END = 0.05        # attempt 23 / direction 1: evasion ends when the 0.5 s window-average d_near rate > this [m/s] (was 0.1)


_DDOT_WIN_MIN = 0.02    # attempt 23 / direction 5: evasion ends when the 1.0 s (_EV_INC_S) window-average d_near rate > this [m/s]


_EV_INC_SHORT = 0.5     # attempt 23 / direction 1: short evasion-end window [s] used with _DDOT_END and the far case


_EV_STILL_S = 0.5       # attempt 23: stationary-mover end window [s], kept at the attempt-22 value (was _EV_INC_S)
```
